system_prompt: You are a precise data extraction engine. Output only JSON.
user_template:
Extract metadata and benchmark scores for the model "Aurora-Lite 14B Instruct" from the two web pages below. Use only values stated on the pages for this exact model; ignore scores of other models, earlier preview versions, non-thinking mode and alternative settings mentioned in footnotes. If a value is not on the pages, use null.

Return JSON matching this schema:
{
  "model_name": string,
  "params_b": number (total parameters in billions, e.g. 7.5),
  "context_window": integer (maximum context length in tokens),
  "license": string,
  "release_date": string (YYYY-MM-DD),
  "benchmarks": [ {"name": string, "score": number}, ... ]
}

In "benchmarks", include one entry per benchmark from this list, using these exact names: MMLU-Pro, GPQA Diamond, AIME 2025, LiveCodeBench, SWE-bench Verified, BFCL v3, τ²-bench, IFEval, MMMU, RULER 128k, HumanEval, MATH-500, Arena Elo, Agentic Index, Coding Index. Scores are plain numbers without "%" signs.
Output only the JSON object, with no explanation and no Markdown.
